name: FEX for the x86-64 Steam client
note: FEX-Emu 2610 built for the Linux runtime by tools/fex/build-in-arch.sh in the DroidDeck repository (patches in tools/fex/patches, host thunks included). r5 bundles libxxhash, which the runtime does not ship, beside libFEXCore with RUNPATH $ORIGIN/../lib on the programs that need it. droiddeck-steam-x64 downloads it for the optional x86-64 Steam client and pins this sha256. Mirrored from The412Banner/DroidDeck release fex-2610-r5.
